result.task:
Investigate why KalshiML shows "no_ensemble_yet" for NYC HIGH contracts.

Focus ONLY on these 3 files: run_ensemble_search.py, ensemble_optimizer.py, and daily_part_06.py.
Read each one, identify what triggers "no_ensemble_yet", and report the root cause in 2-3 sentences.

Do NOT read any other files. Do NOT check issues or logs. Do NOT modify anything.
result.final_answer: **Root cause:** "no_ensemble_yet" is emitted by `daily_part_06.py` when it looks up a champion config in `ensemble_champions.json` (written by `ensemble_optimizer.py` via `run_ensemble_search.py`) and finds no entry for the (NYC, temp/HIGH, lead-bucket) key. `ensemble_optimizer.py` only writes a champion when `prevruns_history.parquet` contains enough settled samples for that city/variable/bucket combo — NYC HIGH has too little settled history, so no champion was ever generated for it. Compounding this, `run_ensemble_search.py` exits early with "No new data since last run" whenever the prevruns archive mtime isn't newer than the last optimizer run, so even as data slowly accumulates the search may not rerun to pick it up.
